title: Legal request (legal-function-os, v1)
description: One legal request as read by legal-function-os. An input file is a JSON array of these objects, and each id must be unique within it. Omitted and null optional fields take their default. Fields not listed here pass through unchanged; prefix your own fields with x_ so they are never mistaken for a misspelled request field.

id.description: Unique request identifier, for example REQ-1001.

title.description: Short title shown in the board pack and request register.

type.description: Request type, which selects the owning queue: commercial_contract (Commercial), vendor_review (Commercial), dpa (Privacy), privacy_query (Privacy), ai_governance (Legal Ops (AI)), corporate (Corporate / GC), fundraising (Corporate / GC), employment (Employment), dispute (Litigation), ip (Commercial). A non-EEA transfer routes to Privacy whatever the type. Any other value, or none, goes to General and is flagged for manual triage.

counterparty.description: The other party, for the register. Not used in decisions.

value_band.description: Contract or claim value band, lowest first. Matched exactly, so '>1m' is valid and '>1M' is rejected. Omitted means 'none'.

personal_data.description: Personal data is processed. Default false.

non_eea_transfer.description: Data is transferred outside the EEA. Default false.

uncapped_liability.description: The counterparty asks for uncapped liability. Default false.

urgency.description: How soon the requester needs an answer. Omitted means 'standard'.

requested_by.description: Requesting team, for example sales or product.

sla_breached.description: The response SLA has already been missed. Default false.

description.description: Free-text description. Read by the operational list and knowledge portal outputs; not used in decisions.

summary.description: Short summary for the knowledge portal. Not used in decisions.

facts.description: Known facts, one string each. Read by the agent-run and operational list outputs; not used in decisions.

deadline.description: Due date as text, for example 2026-12-01. Shown in the operational list and the shared space; not used in decisions.

dependencies.description: What the request waits on, for example other request ids. Shown in the operational list; not used in decisions.

awaiting_business_input.description: The business still owes legal an answer. Counted in the operational list and shown to the requester in the shared space. Default false.
